summary: Retest of updated matrix (header/studio/footer logo badges, modelaz-nehtu photo replacement, large-font layout at 1280x900). 10 browser checks + 5 backend test cases (3 files) all passed on final run. One flaky browser check (chat-klara-answers-price) failed once on transient 429 console errors, passed clean on rerun -> classified flaky, not a bug.

checks.criterion: Nové logo studia je vidět v hlavičce, menu i patičce (header-logo-badge, studio-logo-badge, footer-logo-badge)
checks.name: logo-badges-visible
checks.evidence: header-logo-badge, studio-logo-badge, footer-logo-badge all visible; their *-image elements have naturalWidth > 0.

checks.criterion: Fotka u služby 'Modeláž nehtů' už není ta růžová — nahrazena novou fotkou z static.prod-images.emergentagent.com
checks.name: service-photo-modelaz-updated
checks.evidence: service-card-modelaz-nehtu contains with src including static.prod-images.emergentagent.com and naturalWidth > 0.

checks.name: desktop-large-font-no-horizontal-scroll
checks.evidence: At 1280x900, scrollWidth<=innerWidth+2; h1 'STUDIO M' and all h2 section headings visible.

checks.name: mobile-responsive-no-horizontal-scroll
checks.evidence: At 390x844, scrollWidth (390) <= innerWidth (390)+2; hero-cta-book-button visible/enabled; studio-menu-cards/menu-card-cenik visible (re-ran persisted check).

checks.criterion: Úvodní stránka se načte bez console errors a bez requestů se statusem >= 400
checks.name: homepage-loads-clean
checks.evidence: hero-photo-left/right, hero-cta-book-button, hero-secondary-wizard-button visible; images naturalWidth>0; no response>=400 (re-ran persisted check).

checks.criterion: Ceník a předvolba služby fungují dál (5 karet, cena Kč, tlačítko PODROBNĚJI)
checks.name: pricing-list-loads-services
checks.evidence: 5 service-card-<id> found for all seeded services; each has price with Kč and PODROBNĚJI button (re-ran persisted check).

checks.criterion: Klik na service-select-btn-<id> scrolluje na #rezervace a wizard je v kroku 2
checks.name: service-select-jumps-to-step2
checks.evidence: booking-step-date-picker visible and #rezervace in viewport after clicking service-select-btn-* (re-ran persisted check).

checks.criterion: Rezervace end-to-end přes průvodce funguje dál
checks.name: booking-e2e-flow
checks.evidence: Selected service, weekday slot, filled name/phone -> booking-success-confirmation visible (re-ran persisted check).

checks.name: test_create_booking_end_to_end / test_availability_closed_on_sunday
checks.evidence: POST /api/bookings -> 200 persisted booking (calendar_synced=false per spec deviation); duplicate slot -> 409; Sunday availability closed=true.

checks.name: chat-klara-answers-price
checks.evidence: First run failed on transient 'Failed to load resource: 429' console errors while waiting for hero-cta-book-button (30s timeout). Rerun immediately after passed cleanly with reply mentioning price in Kč. No backend 4xx/5xx confirmed via passing rerun and backend test below -> classified flaky, not a bug.

checks.name: test_chat_returns_price_answer / test_chat_history_is_retrievable
checks.evidence: POST /api/chat -> 200 non-empty reply mentioning Kč; GET /api/chat/{session_id} -> turns array >=2 entries.

checks.criterion: AI studio fotonáhled reaguje na volby (finish/shape/length options)
checks.name: ai-studio-preview-reacts-to-choices
checks.evidence: Clicking finish-option-mat, shape-option-oval, length-option-3 changed active button class and nail-preview-caption text; active photo naturalWidth>0 (re-ran persisted check).

notes: Updated logo-badges-visible check to also assert header-logo-badge (new testid per updated matrix), in addition to studio-logo-badge and footer-logo-badge.
Added new check service-photo-modelaz-updated for the modelaz-nehtu photo replacement criterion (static.prod-images.emergentagent.com source, naturalWidth>0).

Added new check desktop-large-font-no-horizontal-scroll for 1280x900 layout criterion; combined with existing mobile-responsive-no-horizontal-scroll (390x844) to cover both viewports in the criterion.
Backend suite (3 files, 5 tests) re-ran clean via pytest in 6.41s.
spec_deviations honored: calendar_synced=false expected (no Google Calendar secret); AI-generated design image not part of acceptance.
